title: (RHBA-2020:1257) Update to Fuse 7.6.0 dv-operator image
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.6.0 update of 'DV Operator' image.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* DV Operator image (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.6 on OpenShift, see the
following section of the Fuse on OpenShift Guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.6/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#patch-images

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.6 Online, see the following
section of the Installing and Operating Fuse Online on OpenShift Container Platform guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.6/html/installing_and_operating_fuse_online_on_openshift_container_platform/managing-fuse-online-on-ocp_ocp
portal_description: This advisory makes available an update to the image for DV Operator for Red Hat Fuse 7.6.0.
abstract: This advisory makes available an update to the image for DV Operator for Red Hat Fuse 7.6.0.
